name: Isobe Kumiko
source:
A newlywed, 22 years old, who just gave birth to her honeymoon baby two months ago.

She started going to “JOY” to relieve childcare stress and maintain her style. She has a good relationship with her husband, a sergeant and executive officer of a machine manufacturer, but because she had the baby too soon, her sex life is slowed down even though she is newly married.

She has excellent intuition and insight, and is not afraid of anything. She also has great energy. She is well-liked by those around her because of her ability to put on a cat-like face.

Milk breast is released whenever her breasts are squeezed, due to her newborn child.
